name: voice-message
title: Voice message
description: A chat voice note: play or pause, a waveform that fills as it plays and doubles as the seek slider, elapsed over total time, and a speed toggle.
docs: Pass src (an address or a data URI), peaks (loudness values on any scale), duration in seconds, sender ("me" sits right in the inverted tone, "them" left in the quiet one) and onPlay. The audio is fetched only as far as its length until play is pressed. The play button keeps its name and reports aria-pressed; the waveform is a slider (click or drag; arrow keys seek 5 seconds, 15 with Shift; Page Up and Down, Home and End) with its value written as "0:12 of 0:42". The speed button goes 1x, 1.5x, 2x. Starting one message pauses the one that was playing, through a tiny shared store (pauseAllPlayback() stops all), and a message that ends returns to its start. Loading shows a spinner and is announced; failure is written out ("Could not load voice message") with Try again. Without peaks a waveform is drawn from the address, the same on server and browser. name, defaultTime and labels tune it.
